summary: The customer wants to design an initial laboratory comparison experiment using MIR ATR and fluorescence to evaluate a spectral measurement interface for classifying heterogeneous model biological tissues.

facts_stated.text: The research group is evaluating a spectral measurement interface using model biological tissues such as chicken muscle, fat, and liver.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: evaluating a spectral measurement interface using model biological tissues such as chicken muscle, fat and liver

facts_stated.text: Sequential measurements may not sample the exact same location on the sample.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: sequential measurements may not sample the same location

facts_stated.text: The project is a laboratory classification study.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: This is a laboratory classification study

targets.purpose: Evaluate and compare MIR ATR and fluorescence information on heterogeneous model tissues
targets.enquiry_quote: compare MIR ATR and fluorescence information

physical_state.enquiry_quote: model biological tissues such as chicken muscle, fat and liver

optical_regime.enquiry_quote: model biological tissues such as chicken muscle, fat and liver

process.value: Material heterogeneity causing spatial sampling mismatch during sequential measurements
process.enquiry_quote: the material is heterogeneous and sequential measurements may not sample the same location

customer_premises.claim: A first comparison experiment will yield a clear and definitive demonstration of what the interface results prove for classification.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: We need a first comparison experiment and a clear statement of what its results would demonstrate.

customer_premises.claim: Comparing MIR ATR and fluorescence information is directly necessary or sufficient to address the issue of sequential measurements sampling different locations.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: We want to compare MIR ATR and fluorescence information, because the material is heterogeneous and sequential measurements may not sample the same location.
